title: Kestrel Payments acquisition
text: In March 2024 Orion Fintech completed the acquisition of Kestrel Payments, a UPI switching start-up, for INR 410 crore.

title: Orion Fintech company profile
text: Orion Fintech is headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana. It was founded in 2015 and runs payment gateways for 3,000 merchants.

title: Tara Bank leadership
text: Meera Nair has been the CEO of Tara Bank since 2022. Tara Bank is a scheduled private bank based in Kochi.

title: Tara Bank board committees
text: The Risk Management Committee of Tara Bank is chaired by Arjun Das, an independent director. The Audit Committee is chaired by Leela Menon.

title: Independent director profiles
text: Arjun Das joined the board of Tara Bank in 2019 after 25 years in credit risk at a public sector bank. Leela Menon joined in 2021.

title: Kestrel Payments product note
text: Kestrel Payments offers UPI Lite with a per-transaction limit of INR 500.

title: Forum: Orion revenue rumour

title: Orion Fintech annual report notice
text: Orion Fintech will publish its FY2025 annual report in December 2026. Revenue figures are not yet public.
